description: TISSEO - Arrêts logiques is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tisséo Voyageurs. Représentation cartographique des arrêts logiques tout mode (bus, Linéo, TAD, métro, tramway, téléphérique, scolaire) du réseau de transport en commun de Tisséo en service et données attributaires associées. L'arrêt logique est une représentation ponctuelle, correspondant au barycentre des arrêts physiques de même nom et de même mode. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are arrêt, bus, tramway, metro, lineo, TAD. The portal shows 1,949 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
